Just Compensation.objective: Bring a Shadowcraft Belt and a set of Shadowcraft Gloves to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.

Keep An Eye Out.objective: Dizzy One-Eye in Booty Bay wants you to retrieve his eye from the Bloodsail Buccaneers.

Kezan's Taint.objective: Accept this talisman, <class>. Accept it and use its power to strike down our mutual enemies.Know that around your neck you carry a piece of history. Kezan was once a grand territory of the Zandalar Empire. Alas, the taint of goblin trade princes would force out my proud brothers and sisters.Kezan is now home to the goblin capital of the Undermine; but know that before the taint, it held greatness. Still to this day Kezan is considered sacred land to my people.

Kezan's Unstoppable Taint.objective: ProgressCall forth your demons, <class>. Let them bask in the energy of Kezan's Taint. Command them on the field of battle! Decimate the enemy!Yes... The time has come to apply the final enhancement to Kezan's Taint. Give me the talisman.

Kodo Roundup.objective: Bring five Tamed Kodos and the Kodo Kombobulator back to Smeed Scrabblescrew at Scrabblescrew's Camp.

Krom'Grul.objective: Recover Sha'ni's Nose-Ring from Krom'Grul and return it to Thal'trak in Kargath. Search the various caves and mines in Dreadmaul Rock.

Leaders of the Fang.objective: Bring the Gems of Cobrahn, Anacondra, Pythas and Serpentis to Nara Wildmane in Thunder Bluff.

Leonid's Letter.objective: Deliver the Sealed Letter to Glix Xizzix in the Undercity.

Locked Away.objective: ProgressAn extremely sturdy cabinet stands before you, securely fastened shut by a built-in lock.  The front of the cabinet is deeply scratched and marked.  This could be surmised as being from numerous and violent failed attempts to reveal whatever secrets the cabinet currently obfuscates from view.If you are going to open this cabinet, you will need to find the key.

Look To The Stars.objective: Locate Zzarc'Vul in the southern ogre mound in Duskwood and return his monocle to Viktori in Darkshire.

Lost But Not Forgotten.objective: Bring a sign of Kron's fate to Misha Tor'kren at the farmstead northwest of Razor Hill.

Lost in the Shadows.objective: Help Pal'juh escape Kolkar Crag and bring news of your success to Master Vornal in Sen'jin Village.

Maelstrom's Wrath.objective: ProgressMolthor delivers word from King Rastakhan, <name>. The royal court is most impressed with your decimation of the Hakkari forces. I am to award you with the final weave in your talisman. Hand it to me.

Malin's Request.objective: Take the Sealed Letter to Archmage Malin in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind.

Rise, Thunderfury!.objective: Present the Dormant Wind Kissed Blade to Highlord Demitrian.

Rite of Strength.objective: Kill Bristlebacks in Brambleblade Ravine and bring 12 Bristleback Belts to Chief Hawkwind in Camp Narache.

Rite of Vision.objective: Consume the Water of the Seers in front of the tribal fire in Bloodhoof Village and follow the vision once it appears. Provided item:

Rites of the Earthmother.objective: Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff wants you to bring him the Horn of Arra'chea.

Riverpaw Gnoll Bounty.objective: Bring 8 Painted Gnoll Armbands to Deputy Rainer at the Barracks.

Robe of Faith.objective: Father Inigo Montoy at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Robe of Faith if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Robe, 25 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 4 Mooncloth and 2 Nexus Crystals.

Rocks to Rests.objective: Return 8 Smooth Boulders to Thra behind Grommash Hold.

Roll the Bones.objective: Bring 8 Dinosaur Bones to Spark Nilminer in Un'Goro Crater.

Root Samples.objective: Bring 8 Root Samples to Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet.

Runecloth.objective: Bring 30 Runecloth to Meilosh in Timbermaw Hold.

Ruuzel.objective: Bring the Ring of Zoram to Talen near the Zoram Strand.

STOLEN: Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Sp.objective: Find and return the Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass to Taskmaster Scrange in the Searing Gorge.The only information you have about these items is the following: They were definitely stolen by Dark Iron dwarves. The Smithing Tuyere is a blacksmithing tool used by blacksmiths and the Lookout's Spyglass is an invaluable monitoring tool to lookouts.

Safety First.objective: Return the Modified Seaforium Booster to Razzeric on the Shimmering Flats.

Samophlange.objective: Return the Samophlange to Sputtervalve in Ratchet.

Samophlange Manual.objective: Bring the Samophlange Manual to Rilli Greasygob in Orgrimmar.

Sample for Helbrim.objective: Bring the Wolf Heart Sample to Apothecary Helbrim in the Barrens.

Sandals of Faith.objective: Father Inigo Montoy at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Sandals of Faith if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Sandals, 12 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 2 Mooncloth and 3 Cured Rugged Hides.

Sarkoth.objective: Kill Sarkoth and bring his claw back to Hana'zua.

Sathrah's Sacrifice.objective: Priestess A'moora wants you to place Lady Sathrah's silvery spinnerets at the fountain inside the temple, and then return to her.

Saving Sharpbeak.objective: Fight to the top of Jintha'Alor, kill Vile Priestess Hexx for the key to Sharpbeak's cage, and save Sharpbeak.

Saving Yenniku.objective: Bring the Filled Soul Gem to Nimboya.

Saving the Best for Last.objective: Give Deliana your Helm of Valor and Breastplate of Valor.

Scavenging Deathknell.objective: Search Deathknell and the vicinity for 6 pieces of Scavenged Goods, and return them to Deathguard Saltain.

Scrounging.objective: Get 7 pieces of Scrap Metal for Sigrun.

Scythe of the Unseen Path.objective: Bring 1 Qiraji Spiked Hilt, 2 Azure Idols, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Warden Haro in Silithus. You must also attain Exalted reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.

Search for Incendicite.objective: Bring 6 loads of Incendicite Ore to Pilot Stonegear in Dun Morogh.

Securing the Lines.objective: Kill 12 Dustwind Savages and 8 Dustwind Storm Witches for Rezlak near Drygulch Ravine.

Separation Anxiety.objective: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to recover his twin brother's remains. Find and return Huntsman Malkhor's Skull and Huntsman Malkhor's Bones to Huntsman Markhor.Markhor mentioned that his brother's remains were fed to the oozes and wolves of the Vilebranch. He also mentioned that there is a refuse pit filled with oozes in Jintha'alor as well as a wolf den. Both of these places are near the top of the temple.

Serena Bloodfeather.objective: Slay Serena Bloodfeather and return her head to Darsok Swiftdagger at the Crossroads.

Serpentbloom.objective: Apothecary Zamah in Thunder Bluff wants you to collect 10 Serpentbloom.

Service to the Horde.objective: It will take time for our scholars to study the pendant you brought us.  But for your service to the Horde I would like to offer you a small token.Thank you, <name>.  Your acts bring honor to you, and to us.

Set Them Ablaze!.objective: Set the North, South, East, and West Sentry Towers on fire by using the Torch of Retribution inside each of the buildings.

Shadoweaver.objective: Kill the group of Shadow Silk Poachers that wander the Searing Gorge. Nilith has reason to believe that there are five of them that need to be exterminated. Return to Nilith in the Searing Gorge when this task is complete.

Shizzle's Flyer.objective: Collect 8 Webbed Diemetradon Scales and 8 Webbed Pterrordax Scales for Shizzle in Marshal's Refuge.

Shoulderpads of Faith.objective: Father Inigo Montoy at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Shoulderpads of Faith if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Shoulderpads, 12 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 2 Mooncloth and 3 Cured Rugged Hides.

Shroud of Infinite Wisdom.objective: Bring 1 Qiraji Martial Drape, 2 Jasper Idols, 5 Gold Scarabs and 5 Clay Scarabs to Keyl Swiftclaw in Silithus. You must also obtain Revered reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.

Shy-Rotam.objective: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to defeat Shy-Rotam.

Signet of Unyielding Strength.objective: Bring 1 Qiraji Magisterial Ring, 2 Lambent Idols, 5 Bronze Scarabs and 5 Ivory Scarabs to Windcaller Yessendra in Silithus. You must also attain Honored reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.

Signet of the Unseen Path.objective: Bring 1 Qiraji Ceremonial Ring, 2 Amber Idols, 5 Gold Scarabs and 5 Clay Scarabs to Windcaller Yessendra in Silithus. You must also attain Honored reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.

Silver of the Waves.objective: Return the monogrammed silver hair clip to its owner.

Skirmish at Echo Ridge.objective: Kill 12 Kobold Laborers, then return to Marshal McBride at Northshire Abbey.

Skull Rock.objective: Gather Searing Collars from the cultists in Skull Rock.Bring them to Margoz at his camp.

Solution to Doom.objective: Bring the Tablet of Ryun'eh to Theldurin the Lost.

Southsea Shakedown.objective: Security Chief Bilgewhizzle of Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris wants you to kill 10 Southsea Pirates, 10 Southsea Freebooters, 10 Southsea Dock Workers and 10 Southsea Swashbucklers.

Souvenirs of Death.objective: Deathguard Samsa of Tarren Mill wants 30 Hillsbrad Human Skulls.

Spellfire Robes.objective: Here are your robes, <name>.  Wear them well

Split Bone Necklace.objective: Bring 25 Split Bone Necklaces to Kin'weelay at the Grom'gol Base camp.

Stalk With The Earthmother.objective: Buy or catch a Raw Brilliant Smallfish, then use the Knife Set to fillet it in front of Boarton Shadetotem in Thunder Bluff.

Stalwart's Battlegear.objective: Bring 15 Cenarion Combat Badges, 20 Cenarion Logistics Badges, 17 Cenarion Tactical Badges and 1 Mark of Remulos to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also attain Revered reputation with Cenarion Circle to be able to complete this quest.

Sting of the Scorpid.objective: Get 10 Scorpid Worker Tails for Gornek in the Den.

Stolen Booty.objective: Retrieve the Shipment of Boots and Telescopic Lens for Gazlowe in Ratchet.

Stolen Silver.objective: Bring the Stolen Silver to Gazrog in the Crossroads.

Stone Is Better than Cloth.objective: Bring some Patterned Bronze Bracers to Lucien Tosselwrench in the Badlands.

Stonetalon Supply Run.objective: Collect 6 Stonetalon Supplies from Pridewing Wyverns and deliver them to Innkeeper Faralia.

Stormcaller's Diadem.objective: Bring Vek'lor's Diadem, 2 Idols of Rebirth, 5 Stone Scarabs and 5 Crystal Scarabs to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.

Stormcaller's Footguards.objective: Bring the Qiraji Bindings of Dominance, 2 Idols of the Sage, 5 Bronze Scarabs and 5 Clay Scarabs to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj. This quest also requires Neutral faction with the Brood of Nozdormu.

Stormcaller's Hauberk.objective: Bring the Carapace of the Old God, 2 Idols of the Sage, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Vethsera inside Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Honored reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.

Stormcaller's Leggings.objective: Bring the Skin of the Great Sandworm, 2 Idols of Strife, 5 Bronze Scarabs and 5 Ivory Scarabs to Kandrostrasz inside Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.

Stormcaller's Pauldrons.objective: Bring the Qiraji Bindings of Dominance, 2 Idols of Life, 5 Gold Scarabs and 5 Crystal Scarabs to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Neutral reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.

Stormy Potential.objective: Bring 5 Charged Thunder Lizard Organs to Rezlak near Drygulch Ravine.

Strange Sources.objective: Follow Donova Snowden's instructions, then report back.

Strength of Mount Mugamba.objective: ProgressIt is good to see you in good health, <name>. The glorious battles you have undertaken affect all life on this planet. Hakkar must never leave the confines of Zul'Gurub as the world will surely collapse beneath his immense hunger.Give me your talisman and I shall amplify its strength. Use the Strength of Mugamba to punish our enemies!

Striker's Diadem.objective: Bring Vek'lor's Diadem, 2 Idols of Strife, 5 Bronze Scarabs and 5 Ivory Scarabs to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.

Striker's Footguards.objective: Bring the Qiraji Bindings of Command, 2 Idols of Life, 5 Stone Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj. This quest also requires Neutral faction with the Brood of Nozdormu.

Striker's Hauberk.objective: Bring the the Carapace of the Old God, 2 Idols of Life, 5 Gold Scarabs and 5 Clay Scarabs to Vethsera inside Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Honored reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.

Striker's Leggings.objective: Bring the Skin of the Great Sandworm, 2 Idols of the Sun, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Kandrostrasz inside Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.

Striker's Pauldrons.objective: Bring the Qiraji Bindings of Command, 2 Idols of War, 5 Crystal Scarabs and 5 Ivory Scarabs to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Neutral reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.

Stromgarde Badges.objective: Bring Stromgarde Badges to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe.

Summoning the Princess.objective: Go to the Shards of Myzrael, summon her and defeat her.Gather her Eldritch Shackles and bind them to the Shards of Myzrael.

Sunken Treasure.objective: Doctor Draxlegauge in Faldir's Cove wants you to collect 10 Elven Gems and return the Goggles of Gem Hunting once you are done.

Superior Armaments of Battle - Friend of.objective: For 30 Insignias of the Dawn and 30 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.

Supervisor Fizsprocket.objective: Kill Supervisor Fizsprocket and return his clipboard to Morin Cloudstalker at Bloodhoof Village.

Supplies to Auberdine.objective: Speak with Delgren the Purifier at Maestra's Post after seeing Feero safely through Ashenvale Forest.

Sweet Amber.objective: Bring Grimbooze Thunderbrew a bundle of Charred Oak.

Syndicate Assassins.objective: Kill 12 Syndicate Footpads and 8 Syndicate Thieves, then return to Magistrate Henry Maleb in Southshore.

The Bait for Lar'korwi.objective: Using the contents of Torwa's Pouch, summon Lar'korwi and defeat him. Then bring Lar'korwi's Head to Torwa Pathfinder near the entrance to Un'Goro Crater.

The Balance of Nature.objective: Kill 7 Young Nightsabers and 4 Young Thistle Boars and return to Conservator Ilthalaine.

The Battle Plans.objective: Bring the Woodpaw Battle Plans to Hadoken Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.

The Battleboars.objective: Grull Hawkwind in Camp Narache wants you to kill Battleboars and bring back 8 Battleboar Snouts and 8 Battleboar Flanks.

The Blackwood Corrupted.objective: Fill the Empty Cleansing Bowl at the Auberdine Moonwell.Gather a sample of fruit, nut, and grain from the northern Blackwood furbolg camps.Mix the bowl and place it near the bonfire closest to the Cliffspring River at the northern camp, thus summoning the satyr corruptor.Take the Talisman of Corruption and bring it to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine.

The Bloodsail Buccaneers.objective: Report your findings to First Mate Crazz in Booty Bay

The Boar Hunter.objective: Talin Keeneye would like you to kill 12 Small Crag Boars.

The Book of Ur.objective: Bring the Book of Ur to Keeper Bel'dugur at the Apothecarium in the Undercity.

The Branch of Cenarius.objective: Kill Geltharis and return the Branch of Cenarius to Illiyana at the Shrine of Aessina.

The Brood of Onyxia.objective: Speak with Overlord Mok'Morokk in Brackenwall Village

The Captain's Chest.objective: Bring Smotts' Chest to Hecklebury Smotts in Booty Bay.

The Chill of Death.objective: Bring five Duskbat Pelts and some Coarse Thread to Gretchen Dedmar in Brill.

The Cirrusfly Queen.objective: Destroy the Cirrusfly Queen in Thendal Grove.

The Coastal Menace.objective: Bring a scale of Old Murk-Eye to Captain Grayson at the Westfall Lighthouse.

The Completed Orb of Dar'Orahil.objective: Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete the Orb of Dar'Orahil and then speak to her again.

The Completed Orb of Noh'Orahil.objective: Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete the Orb of Noh'Orahil and then speak to her again.

The Completed Robe.objective: Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete your robe and then speak to her again.

The Corpulent One.objective: Find Borelgore in the northern wastes of Eastern Plaguelands and destroy him. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller when the mission is complete.

The Corrupter.objective: Slay Lord Azrethoc and Jugkar Grim'rod and return to Takata Steelblade in Desolace.

The Criminal Element.objective: Kill 10 Highlands Bandits and their leader, "Badwind" Bennic in the Shen'dar Highlands.

The Crown of Will.objective: Kill 14 Crushridge Maulers for Melisara in Tarren Mill.

The Crystal of Zin-Malor.objective: Deliver the Crystal of Zin-Malor to Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.

The Curse of the Tides.objective: Destroy the Altar of the Tides with Catelyn's Blade, kill Gazban and bring the Stone of the Tides and Catelyn's Blade back to Baron Revilgaz.

The Damned.objective: Novice Elreth requires 6 Scavenger Paws and 6 Duskbat Wings.

The Darkreaver Menace.objective: Use the Divination Scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement in the Scholomance. Doing so will bring forth spirits you must fight. Defeating these spirits will summon forth Death Knight Darkreaver; defeat him.Bring Darkreaver's Head to Sagorne Creststrider in the Valley of Wisdom, Orgrimmar.

The Dead Fields.objective: Kill rot hide gnolls at the Dead Fields.When Nightlash appears, kill her.Bring the Essence of Nightlash to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.

The Defense of Grom'gol.objective: Commander Aggro'gosh of the Grom'gol base camp wants you to kill 10 Ogre Brutes and 5 Ogre Witch Doctors.

The Demon Scarred Cloak.objective: Find someone who knows of Ghost Howl. Provided item:

The Demon Seed.objective: Grab a Flawed Power Stone. Bring it to the Altar of Fire before the stone expires, then return to Ak'Zeloth.

The Den.objective: Travel to the Den on Stonetalon Peak. Using the Gatekeeper's Key, obtain the druids' hidden items. Use these items to open the Talon Den Hoard.

The Disruption Ends.objective: Kill 8 Razormane Geomancers, 8 Razormane Defenders, and Kreenig Snarlsnout.Then bring Kreenig Snarlsnout's Tusk to Thork at the Crossroads.

The Dunemaul Compound.objective: Andi Lynn in Gadgetzan wants you to destroy the Dunemaul Compound by killing 10 Dunemaul Brutes, 10 Dunemaul Enforcers, and Gor'marok the Ravager.

The Enchanted Glade.objective: Acquire 6 Bloodfeather Belts and bring them to Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak in the Oracle Glade.

The Escape.objective: Protect Wizzlecrank and the stolen goblin shredder on the way to Sputtervalve in Ratchet.

The Everstill Bridge.objective: Bring 5 Iron Pikes and 5 Iron Rivets to Foreman Oslow in Lakeshire.

The Eye of Command.objective: ProgressDrek'Thar sings your praises. Kalimdor is abuzz with tales of your heroics. The Warchief glows - your stalwart defense of our clan has pleased him greatly.You have earned the Eye of Command.Present your insignia, Commander <name>.

The Eye of Zuldazar.objective: ProgressTales of your battles against the Gurubashi are whispered in the winds, <class>. Even royalty is beginning to talk of your deeds. It is rumored that King Rastakhan even mentioned you by name.The time has come to imbue the Eye. Hand me the talisman and I shall perform the service.

The Fall of Kel'Thuzad.objective: Take the Phylactery of Kel'Thuzad to Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

The Fall of Ossirian.objective: Deliver the Head of Ossirian the Unscarred to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

The Family Crypt.objective: Kill 8 Wailing Ancestors and 8 Rotting Ancestors.Kill Captain Dargol, and bring his skull to Magistrate Sevren in Brill.

The Final Message to the Wildhammer.objective: Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to travel to Aerie Peak in the western region of the Hinterlands and place the Final Message to the Wildhammer by the well in the center of town. Return to him once this task is complete.Beware of angry Wildhammer dwarves and unruly members of the Alliance.

The Forging of Quel'Serrar.objective: You must get Onyxia to breathe fire on the Unfired Ancient Blade. Once this is done, pick up the now Heated Ancient Blade. Be warned, a Heated Ancient Blade will not remain heated forever - time is of the essence.The last step before returning to me is to slay the beast and drive the Heated Ancient Blade into her corpse.Do this and Quel'Serrar will be yours.

The Fragments Within.objective: Report back what you have found to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine

The Fury Runs Deep.objective: Motley Garmason wants Kam Deepfury's head brought to him at Dun Modr.

The God Hakkar.objective: Bring the Filled Egg of Hakkar to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.

The Grand Invoker.objective: ProgressNever have I seen such tenacity! The Bronze Flight grants you one final enchantment. The Timeless One himself has requested it so!Hand me your signet ring so that I may make the necessary adjustments.

The Great Fras Siabi.objective: Find Fras Siabi's smoke shop in Stratholme and recover a box of Siabi's Premium Tobacco. Return to Smokey LaRue when the job is done.

The Green Drake.objective: Bring the Tooth of Morphaz to Ogtinc in Azshara. Ogtinc resides atop the cliffs northeast the Ruins of Eldarath.

The Green Hills of Stranglethorn.objective: Collect the missing pages from The Green Hills of Stranglethorn manuscript. Once all four chapters are complete, return them to Barnil.

The Guns of Northwatch.objective: Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun of Ratchet wants you to collect 10 Theramore Medals and slay Captain Fairmount, Cannoneer Whessan and Cannoneer Smythe.

The Heart of Hakkar.objective: Bring the Heart of Hakkar to Molthor on Yojamba Isle.

The Heathen's Brand.objective: Know this, heathen: A catastrophe has brought us together. Your pagan ways are neither understood nor appreciated by Zandalar but we are a fair people. Wear this brand around your neck. It shall serve as both a warning to our enemies and a symbol of your friendship to Zandalar.Continue to serve our people and I will amplify the power of the brand.

The Hidden Chamber.objective: Read Baelog's Journal, explore the hidden chamber, then report to Prospector Stormpike.

The Hidden Key.objective: Use the Small Brass Key to open Bookie Herod's Strongbox.

The High Chieftain.objective: Seek audience with High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff

The Hunt Begins.objective: Grull Hawkwind in Camp Narache wants you to bring him 7 Plainstrider Feathers and 7 pieces of Plainstrider Meat.

The Hunt Completed.objective: <name>, you have slain all three beasts that comprise the Ashenvale Hunt.  You have brought me adequate proof of their demise; there is no question of your strength and tenacity.  The blood of a hunter streaks through your veins, and you should be commended!Please, accept this bauble as a sign of congratulations on your mighty deeds done in Ashenvale for the Horde today.  May your ancestors watch over you!

The Hunt Continues.objective: Grull Hawkwind in Camp Narache wants you to bring him 10 Mountain Cougar Pelts.

The Karnitol Shipwreck.objective: Return to Kreldig Ungor in Desolace

The Killing Fields.objective: Farmer Saldean wants you to kill 20 Harvest Watchers.

The Legend of Korrak.objective: According to legend, the leader of the mighty Winterax trolls appears at will to wreak havoc on the denizens of Alterac Valley.Should Korrak make himself known, destroy him and return to Warmaster Laggrond.

The Legend of Stalvan.objective: Kill Stalvan Mistmantle and show Madame Eva his family ring.

The Lich, Ras Frostwhisper.objective: Find Ras Frostwhisper in the Scholomance. When you have found him, use the Soulbound Keepsake on his undead visage. Should you succeed in reverting him to a mortal, strike him down and recover the Human Head of Ras Frostwhisper. Take the head back to Magistrate Marduke.

The Lord of Blackrock.objective: Venture to the Valley of Heroes in Stormwind City and speak with Field Marshal Afrasiabi

The Lost Pages.objective: Find the 12 missing pages of the Shredder Operating Manual, and put them together to form Chapters 1, 2, and 3. Return the pages to Gurda Ragescar near Splintertree Post.

The Maelstrom's Tendril.objective: ProgressAh, <name>, it is good to smell you again.You'll have to excuse my sense of humor. It can be most foul at times.I sense that you have caused great anguish to our enemies. The forces of Hakkar cry out your name in anger. This is most excellent.You have earned another weave on your talisman. Hand it to me.

The Mark of Quality.objective: Bring 10 Thick Yeti Hides to Jangdor Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.

The Mighty U'cha.objective: Bring U'cha's Pelt to Torwa Pathfinder at the entrance of Un'Goro Crater.

The Mills Overrun.objective: Gather 5 Notched Ribs and 3 Blackened Skulls, then return to Deathguard Dillinger in Brill.

The Mindless Ones.objective: Shadow Priest Sarvis wants you to kill 8 Mindless Zombies and 8 Wretched Zombies.

The Missing Diplomat.objective: Speak to Mikhail in the Wetlands

The Moonsilver Blade.objective: Bring Ott's Masterwork to Trevan Rol in Silverpine Forest.

The Morrow Stone.objective: Return the Sparkling Stone and the Stave of Equinex to Troyas Moonbreeze in Feathermoon Stronghold.

The Mystery of Morrowgrain.objective: Bring 10 Morrowgrain to Quintis Jonespyre in Feathermoon Stronghold.

The New Plague.objective: Collect the Highly Toxic Strain from Witherfang in Ruins of Lordaeron for Theodore Griffs in Undercity.

The Nightmare Manifests.objective: Defend Nighthaven from Eranikus. Do not let Keeper Remulos perish. Do not slay Eranikus. Defend yourself. Await Tyrande.

The Only Prescription.objective: Recover the 8 lost chapters of Draconic for Dummies and combine them with the Magical Book Binding and return the completed book of Draconic for Dummies: Volume II to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.

The Only Song I Know....objective: Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants you to bring him 2 Frozen Runes, 2 Essence of Water, 2 Blue Sapphires and 30 gold pieces.

The Orb of Soran'ruk.objective: Find 3 Soran'ruk Fragments and 1 Large Soran'ruk Fragment and return them to Doan Karhan in the Barrens.

The Path of the Conqueror.objective: ProgressYou honor my kind, <name>. Strike down the enemies of Kalimdor! Show them what it means to deface the land of eternal starlight.You have earned another enhancement. Hand me your signet ring so that I may bolster its power.

The Perfect Stout.objective: Bring 6 Shimmerweeds to Rejold Barleybrew in the Brewnall Village.

The Power to Destroy....objective: Bring the books Spells of Shadow and Incantations from the Nether to Varimathras in Undercity.

The Prodigal Lich Returns.objective: Bring the Nether Gem to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.

The Protector of Kalimdor.objective: ProgressNever have I seen such tenacity! The Bronze Flight grants you one final enchantment. The Timeless One himself has requested it so!Hand me your signet ring so that I may make the necessary adjustments.

The Rage of Mugamba.objective: ProgressKing Rastakhan sends his regards, Master <name>. Such an honor has never been given to one outside the Zandalar tribe.Give me your talisman so that I may enhance it once more. Know that the Rage of Mugamba is now intrinsically connected to your very soul.

The Real Threat.objective: Slay Or'Kalar and bring his Head to Korin Fel in the Hammerfall outpost.

The Red Messenger.objective: Kill Meven Korgal, the messenger, at the Crusader camp, then return any information you find to Executor Arren.

The Relics of Wakening.objective: Retrieve the Relics of Wakening and bring them to Athridas Bearmantle in Dolanaar.

The Remains of Trey Lightforge.objective: Return the Remains of Trey Lightforge to Jessir Moonbow in Felwood.

The Rescue.objective: Krusk in Tarren Mill needs you to free Drull and Tog'thar from Durnholde Keep.

The Restless Dead.objective: Kill 15 Enraged Apparitions, 10 Tormented Souls and put the spirit of Anvilmar to rest.

The Rise of the Machines.objective: Find and slay Golem Lord Argelmach. Return his head to Lotwil. You will also need to collect 10 Intact Elemental Cores from the Ragereaver Golems and Warbringer Constructs protecting Argelmach. You know this because you are psychic.

The Sacred Flame.objective: Retrieve the Cloven Hoof for Rau Cliffrunner at the Freewind Post.

The Savior of Kalimdor.objective: Take the Eye of C'Thun to Anachronos at the Caverns of Time.

The Scarlet Crusade.objective: Bring Executor Arren 12 Scarlet Armbands from Scarlet Converts and Scarlet Initiates.

The Scarlet Oracle, Demetria.objective: The Scarlet Crusade is on the move. Somewhere along the road from Tyr's Hand to Stratholme you will find the Oracle, Demetria, and her entourage. Hunt her down and slay her. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller should you succeed.

The Shattered Hand.objective: Kill Tazan and bring his Satchel to Therzok in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar.

The Shieldsmith.objective: Bring the Cask of Scalder to Furen Longbeard.

The Skybreaker Bulwark.objective: Reclaim the Skybreaker Bulwark from Zaal Stormshield at the Shrine of Akir.

The Sleeper Has Awakened.objective: Escort Kerlonian Evershade to Liladris Moonriver south along the road to find his bag in Darkshore.

The Smoldering Ruins of Thaurissan.objective: Listen to Royal Historian Archesonus recant the history of Thaurissan.

The Stolen Journal.objective: Grelin Whitebeard wants you to kill Grik'nir the Cold, and retrieve his journal.

The Test of Righteousness.objective: Wait for Jordan Stilwell to finish forging a weapon for you

The Thandol Span.objective: Rhag Garmason wants you to locate Ol' Rustlocke

The Tome of Valor.objective: Defend Daphne Stilwell from the Defias attack.Neither of your spirits must be released from their mortal coils if you wish to succeed.After you are successful, speak to Daphne Stilwell again.

The Totem of Infliction.objective: Bring 10 Ghoul Fangs, 10 Skeleton Fingers and 5 Vials of Spider Venom to Madame Eva in Darkshire.
